description: Defines the LoanScheduleModelDisbursementPeriod class representing a disbursement period in a loan schedule, including methods for data conversion and state management.

classes.name: LoanScheduleModelDisbursementPeriod
classes.description: Represents a loan disbursement period with properties like disbursement date, principal disbursed, and charges due at disbursement.

methods.name: disbursement
methods.description: Factory method to create a disbursement period instance with specified date, principal, and charges.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the disbursement period to a data transfer object for external use.

methods.name: isRepaymentPeriod
methods.description: Indicates this is not a repayment period.

methods.name: isDownPaymentPeriod
methods.description: Indicates this is not a down payment period.

methods.name: periodNumber
methods.description: Returns null as disbursement periods do not have a period number.

methods.name: periodFromDate
methods.description: Returns null; not applicable for disbursement periods.

methods.name: periodDueDate
methods.description: Returns null; not applicable for disbursement periods.

methods.name: principalDue
methods.description: Returns null; not applicable for disbursement periods.

methods.name: interestDue
methods.description: Returns null; not applicable for disbursement periods.

methods.name: feeChargesDue
methods.description: Returns null; not applicable for disbursement periods.

methods.name: penaltyChargesDue
methods.description: Returns null; not applicable for disbursement periods.

methods.name: addLoanCharges
methods.description: Adds fee and penalty charges to the charges due at disbursement.

methods.name: isRecalculatedInterestComponent
methods.description: Returns false; interest is not recalculated for this period.

methods.name: addPrincipalAmount
methods.description: No operation; disbursement period does not add principal amount.

methods.name: addInterestAmount
methods.description: No operation; disbursement period does not add interest amount.

methods.name: getLoanCompoundingDetails
methods.description: Returns null; no compounding details for this period.

methods.name: setEMIFixedSpecificToInstallmentTrue
methods.description: Sets the EMI fixed specific to installment flag to true.

methods.name: isEMIFixedSpecificToInstallment
methods.description: Checks if EMI fixed specific to installment is set.

methods.name: rescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: Returns null; no rescheduling interest portion.

methods.name: setRescheduleInterestPortion
methods.description: No operation; reschedule interest portion not set.
